newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currencies end down on dlr short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currencies end down on dlr short-covering.

text.p: Sept 25 - Most IMM currencies ended lower, as dollar short-covering continued in the afternoon. Traders said futures were correcting their overdone rally from Tuesday. Technicals also exacerbated selling pressure in yen, marks, Swiss francs. Mark/lira weakened, supporting dollar's rise vs marks. -Derivatives Desk/(312) 408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
